notes.title: Free Update #3
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Additional Feature “Lamb Roast α and Lamb Roast β”[/b][/h3]
Lamb Roast α and Lamb Roast β are two battle mini-games.
Lamb Roast α measures damage over a short period of time.
Lamb Roast β allows you to change the opponent into any monster you wish.
You'll earn various rewards based on your performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191464/0c25d4fde366ca1875167472ec5f7367c38a96a2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191464/18224e1526e5a96677fdb65ffd57b20795bec965.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Additional Feature “Hunting Book”[/b][/h3]
Search for monster traces based on the information in the Hunting Book.
By scanning traces, you can battle a number of different enemies. The enemies grow stronger as you progress, culminating in fights against mighty foes.
We encourage you to take up the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191464/e7efec804258cb6b0233a8975832fb19a5171ab5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191464/88f0f061836c805420e4b22b45456f54524642b2.jpg[/img]
*In order to play “Lamb Roast α and Lamb Roast β” and “Hunting Book”, you must advance to a specific point in the game.

notes.title: Free Update #2
notes.notes:
[h3][b]■Building Expansion Update[/b][/h3]
New building materials have been added, including new Feature Modules such as the “Energy Sphere”, which allows players to restore their energy and the “Projector” that allows players to create shadows of previously defeated monsters. Additionally, a new architectural style and matching furniture based on Ryza’s hometown, Kurken Island, from “Atelier Ryza” have also been added.
Have more freedom to create!

[h3][b]■Higher Difficulty Level Patch[/b][/h3]
The hardest difficulty level, “Legendary”, has been added.
Enemy stats have been increased and supporting allies’ HP will slowly decrease when in combat within the manabound area.
Enjoy an even more challenging adventure!

Note: Some of the information were corrected on May 26th.

notes.title: Free Update #1
notes.notes:
[h3][b]■Photo Mode Special Update[/b][/h3]
New photo frames and motions have been added in "Photo Mode," where you can freely position characters, change the time of day, filters, frames, and character expressions, and enjoy taking pictures. Take your best shot in the upgraded "Photo Mode".

[h3][b]■"Atelier Resleriana" Hand-Picked BGM Pack[/b][/h3]
Adds BGM tracks from "Atelier Resleriana" that can be used to change the in-game BGM.
Enjoy a set of 10 tracks from "Atelier Resleriana" Hand-Picked BGM.

*The BGM pack is accessible after unlocking base building and placing certain furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191464/65b8a70fce7d826cdead6b4ca809af8a317ce86b.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]■Special Items Set[/b][/h3]
"Wishlist Campaign Goal" reached present!
Receive one "Scarlet Scarf" accessory, and building materials.

Scarlet Scarf increases maximum HP.
Obtain 200 pieces each of the following building materials: "Wood," "Stone," "Iron," "Powder," "Saltpeter," and "Fiber."

*Building materials can be checked after Building is unlocked.
*You cannot receive more than the storage limit of exploration pouches or material boxes.
*The recipe for the "Scarlet Scarf" can be obtained by progressing through the game.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Carrying over save data from the demo version
notes.notes:
Carrying over Steam® demo save data to the Steam® release version
The following two conditions must be met in order to carry over save data from the Steam® demo to the Steam® release version:
• There must be save data from the demo version on the system you are using.
• There must not be existing save data from the release version on the system you are using.

If the two above conditions are met, a screen will be displayed asking if you wish to carry over save data when you start up the release version. If you follow the on-screen instructions and choose to transfer, then the save data from the demo version will be imported as release version save data. (The save data file from the demo version will be copied to the save data folder for the release version.)

Note: When you load save data that was imported from the demo version, achievements related to story progress that you made in the demo version will be unlocked.
